coverage_semantics: A covered entry is an exact BootEdit function-inventory extent with a hash-bound readable C++ behavioral model for all evidenced product state and control flow in that extent. ImGui drawing, XDK filesystem/thread/synchronization calls, and already separated library operations are explicit dependency boundaries. Coverage is not a claim of recompilation identity or statement-for-statement decompilation.
authorship_policy: Product coverage identifies the reconstruction queue and is not a claim that a named individual personally authored every instruction in the covered extent.

image.format: memory-layout PE image extracted from PeerPressure/System/BootEdit.xex
